description: This file defines the 'ModuleDefaultPage' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing default page configurations for modules, including properties like action, enable class, priority, and related user roles and modules. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: ModuleDefaultPage
classes.description: An entity class representing default page settings for a module, including fields for action, enable class, priority, user role, and module, mapped with Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the ModuleDefaultPage.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the ModuleDefaultPage.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with this default page, if any.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action for this default page.

methods.name: getEnableClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class used to enable/disable the page.

methods.name: setEnableClass
methods.description: Sets the CSS class for enabling/disabling the page.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this default page setting.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority for this default page.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the UserRole associated with this default page.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Sets the UserRole associated with this default page.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module associated with this default page.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the Module associated with this default page.
